briefdescription.para: This function signs a message with the fixed ML-DSA-44 private key and verifies the signature against the matching public key.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the sign and verify both succeed.

inbodydescription.para: Common client parameters used for every request.
Sign the test message with the fixed private key (pure ML-DSA, hedged, no context). ShaType and ShaMode stay at zero: FIPS 204 only uses them for HashML-DSA.
Verify the produced signature against the fixed public key.
A signature counts as verified only when the server status and the redundant verified indicator both say so, so that a single glitched value cannot pass a bad signature.

briefdescription.para: This function blocks until the client library notifies request completion and returns the server-reported status.

ErrorStatus reported by the server otherwise.
